§7Break to Place End Portal.
Portal Frame area must be cleared.

§4Break with Caution.
§7Note that using silk touch or create mod drill
can return you the block without using it up.

item.create_ss_crate.end_portal_breaker_:
§7Break to Activate.
When Activated, all End Portal Frame and End Portal
in a 5x5x5 area will be broken.

§4Break with Caution.
§7Note that using silk touch or create mod drill
can return you the block without using it up.
§7Break to Place Spawner.
Spawns: Chicken, Cow, Pig, Sheep
Required Blocks: Grass Block

§4Break with Caution.
§7Tip: Move with Minecart Contraption
Note that using silk touch or create mod drill
can return you the block without using it up.

create_ss_crate.jei.info.end_portal_plac:
§0This Crate allows you to place in the end portal frame automatically. This can be helpful as end portal frames must be placed in specific direction for them to work. Simply break the crate to activate it. The portal will be placed around the crate in a 5x5 area. If there are blocks in the way where the portal frame is located, the portal will not be placed.
If you use silk touch or create mod drill, you can get the block back without using it up.
create_ss_crate.jei.info.end_portal_brea:
§0This Crate allows you to break End Portal Frames as well as the End Portal blocks itself. Simply break the crate to activate it. The crate will then break all End Portal Frames and End Portal Blocks in a 5x5x5 area around itself. Any other blocks will remain unaffected.
If you use silk touch or create mod drill, you can get the block back without using it up.
create_ss_crate.jei.info.barn_spawner_cr:
§0This is a Special Crate, rewarded when you first obtain a Starter Crate.

Break to Place Spawner.
Spawns: Chicken, Cow, Pig, Sheep
Required Blocks: Grass Block

Break with Caution as this item will only be rewarded once. You can move this with a Minecart Contraption if needed.
If you use silk touch or create mod drill, you can get the block back without using it up.
§0This is a decorative crate with the texture of the Barn Spawner Crate. It has no practical functionality.

create_ss_crate.advancement.base.root.de: Start your adventure, collecting materials from Crates!
create_ss_crate.advancement.branch.tutor: If you want help in progression, you can always refer to this advancement tree for a guide to see what crate to aim for next!
create_ss_crate.advancement.branch.jei.d: Although JEI is optional, having it installed allows you to see the recipe, loot tables, and extra information about crates. Highly recommended when playing this mod!
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.dirt_cr: The most basic of crates made of pure dirt. Allows you to advance with oak saplings.
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.wood_cr: The crate provides all the materials needed for a cobblestone generator.
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.starter: Welcome to the stone age! This crate can give you a taste of iron in the form of nuggets, needed for the next crate.
create_ss_crate.advancement.special.barn: This is a special crate as a reward for the progress so far. You will only get this crate once.
create_ss_crate.advancement.branch.barn_: This is a purely decorative version of the special Barn Spawner Crate if you wish to use it as a decorative block.
create_ss_crate.advancement.special.work: This is a special crate as a reward for making new crates. You will only get this crate once per new andesite crate type.
create_ss_crate.advancement.branch.works: This is a purely decorative version of the special Workshop Crate if you wish to use it as a decorative block.
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.stone_c: Andesite is the MVP of this crate, allowing you to make Andesite Alloy in Create!
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.ore_cra: Vanilla mining trip packed into a crate.
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.andesit: The Shell of a Crate for more Advanced Crate Recipes
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.nether_: A supply for some of the common blocks found in the nether.
create_ss_crate.advancement.base.blazing: A hotter version of the Nether Crate, and is the Logo of the Mod!
